nodes.text: Commander, welcome to the Command Center. The station is humming at 94% efficiency. How may I serve your objectives today?
I have three active operations. The Kepler outpost needs surveillance. There's a logistics run to the Orion hub. And we've detected anomalies in the plasma core—repair mission, class 4 difficulty.

choices.text: The Orion logistics run sounds good.
I'll handle the plasma core repair.

nodes.text: All systems nominal. Engineering reports 98% engine efficiency. Testing arena shows a 12% bug reduction this cycle. The quantum comm array is stable. Shall I pull up the detailed metrics?
Your record shows consistent performance. Current rank: Ensign. XP: 340. You've completed 8 missions and discovered 5 lore entries. Promotion to Lieutenant requires 160 more XP.
Excellent choice. Launch sequence initiated. Monitor the outpost for 3 cycles. Report any anomalies immediately. Good hunting, Commander.
Cargo manifest uploaded to your terminal. Deliver the quantum processors to Orion hub before the supply chain collapses. Time is of the essence.
Bold move, Commander. The plasma core is volatile. Engineering will brief you on containment protocols. Watch your oxygen levels in that sector.
Pulling up the full dashboard... Here you go. Real-time station telemetry at your fingertips.
Awaiting your return, Commander. The station endures.
